kanban.keineTafel: This document is not a Kanban board
kanban.keineSpalten: This board does not have any columns yet.
kanban.verworfen: The document has changed in the meantime — the change was discarded.
kanban.nurInAnsicht: The board view has to be open for this.
kanban.nurLesbar: This document cannot be changed right now.
kanban.befundeTitel: This board could not be read completely:
kanban.befund.keinKopf: The document has no header section.
kanban.befund.kopfUnlesbar: The header section of the document cannot be read.
kanban.befund.keinKennzeichen: The header section is missing the board marker.
kanban.befund.einstellungsBlockOffen: The settings block at the end of the file is not closed.
kanban.spalteHaktAb: Marks cards dragged into it as done
kanban.spalteLoeschenFrage: The column ‹{titel}› contains {anzahl} cards. Delete it together with its cards?
kanban.spalteLoeschenDetail: The step can be taken back with Undo.
kanban.nichtLeer: Only an empty document can be turned into a Kanban board.
kanban.termin.fremd: Date in the notation of the model tool; rewritten the first time the card is edited
kanban.termin.terminUnlesbar: Date in the notation of the model tool, not readable; it stays as text
kanban.termin.uhrzeitOhneDatum: Time without a date in the notation of the model tool; it stays as text
kanban.termin.tagesnotiz: Open the journal entry for this day
kanban.filterTitel: Filter the cards of this board – Escape ends the filter
kanban.einstellungen.hinweis: Each setting follows the default from Settings → Kanban board or applies its own value to this board only. It is saved in the board document.
kanban.einstellungen.datumZurTagesnotiz: Date leads to the journal entry for the day
kanban.einstellungen.ordnerAusserhalb: The folder is outside the area.
kanban.einstellungen.nichtGeschrieben: The settings block at the end of the board cannot be read — the settings were not written.
kanban.notiz.vorhandenFrage: A document “{name}” already exists. How do you want to continue?
kanban.notiz.ordnerFehlt: The target folder set for this board does not exist — please choose a folder.
kanban.notiz.vorlageFehlt: The template set for this board cannot be found — please choose a template.
kanban.notiz.verworfen: The board has changed in the meantime — the note was created, but the card was not changed.
kanban.notiz.leer: The card has no text from which a note can be created.
settings.kanban.title: Kanban board
settings.kanban.hint: Defaults for all boards. Through View → Kanban board → Settings for this board… a board can override each of them for itself.
settings.kanban.datumTagesnotiz: Date leads to the journal entry for the day
